purpose: Evidence-reviewed WEB negative renderings owned by explicit OpenGNT negative-particle occurrences.

authority.dummyAuxiliaryTreatment: English do/did/does in negative contractions is grammatical support. The explicit OpenGNT negative particle supplies the negative rendering only.

caseEvidence.decision: English contraction contains dummy do/did/does auxiliary plus explicit negation; the Greek negative particle supplies the negation. No lexical-verb ownership is transferred.
